title: IsamasRed: A Public Dataset Tracking Reddit Discussions on Israel-Hamas Conflict
reasoning: The paper includes a dedicated section titled 'Moral Foundations' (page 6) where it analyzes the moral dimensions of discussions related to the conflict. It uses the Domain Adaptation Moral Foundation (DAMF) model to label comments with ten distinct moral foundations, such as care, harm, fairness, loyalty, and purity, which constitutes an evaluation of moral aspects.
